scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "cross-env FRONTEND_PORT=5173 npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:rebuild: node "%npm_config_node_gyp%" rebuild --directory node_modules/better-sqlite3 || node "%APPDATA%/npm/node_modules/npm/node_modules/node-gyp/bin/node-gyp.js" rebuild --directory node_modules/better-sqlite3
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
